questions.question: Run the full appropriation of the R240 000 profit and close both current accounts.
questions.expected_answer: In the agreement's order: salaries Zola 96 000 and Sipho 72 000 (168 000); interest on capital at 10% — Zola 20 000 on 200 000, Sipho 10 000 on 100 000 (30 000); bonus to Sipho 12 000; remainder 240 000 − 210 000 = 30 000, split equally at 15 000 each. Totals: Zola 131 000, Sipho 109 000, together exactly 240 000 — the account empties, proving the division. Current accounts: Zola 4 000 credit + 131 000 − drawings 110 000 = 25 000 credit; Sipho 6 000 debit + 109 000 − 95 000 = 8 000 credit. Salaries and interest are appropriations, never expenses.

questions.question: Process the vehicle disposal in four steps and prove the statement of financial position balances.
questions.expected_answer: Disposal: (1) transfer cost 80 000 out of Vehicles to Asset Disposal; (2) transfer accumulated depreciation 50 000 to Asset Disposal, leaving carrying value 30 000; (3) record proceeds 35 000; (4) difference 5 000 is a profit on disposal — other income. Statement of financial position: non-current assets 335 000 + current assets 168 000 (stock 98 000, debtors 60 000, bank 10 000) = 503 000, financed by partners' equity 333 000 (capitals 300 000 + current accounts 25 000 and 8 000), loan 100 000, and current liabilities 70 000 = 503 000. The notes reconcile fixed assets and show each partner's capital and current account column.

questions.question: Compute the year's indicators and comment as three different readers would.
questions.expected_answer: Gross profit 300 000/900 000 = 33,3% on sales and 50% on cost, matching policy. Net profit 240 000/900 000 = 26,7%. Stock turnover 600 000/100 000 = 6 times; debtors collection 60 000/360 000 × 12 = 2 months — slow against 30-day terms, tighten collections. Creditor's view: current ratio 168 000/70 000 = 2,4 : 1 and acid test 70 000/70 000 = 1 : 1 — liquid, safe. Lender's view: debt-equity 100 000/333 000 = 0,3 : 1 — lightly geared, capacity to borrow. Partners' view: return on average equity 240 000/320 000 = 75%, far above bank rates, remembering partner salaries sit inside that return. Every comment: figure, comparison, judgement.
